title: Larkspur Coast Marathon results
brief: I'm the race director of the Larkspur Coast Marathon and I'm writing up the 2026 results for the committee, who will look at it projected at the debrief on 2026-11-04. Open with headline numbers: 3310 finishers, a record, 4.1 percent who started but did not finish, and winning times of 2:14:08 for the men's race and 2:31:52 for the women's. Under "Finishers by year" chart: 2019 2410, 2020 0 (cancelled), 2021 1130, 2022 2050, 2023 2480, 2024 2790, 2025 3020, 2026 3310. Under "Age groups" give a table of finishers and median finish time: 18 to 29, 612, 4:02; 30 to 39, 1104, 3:55; 40 to 49, 897, 4:01; 50 to 59, 521, 4:14; 60 and over, 176, 4:41. Under "Things to note" a list: 2020 was cancelled, so its zero is not a drop in interest; the 60 and over group was the slowest, at a median of 4:41; the aid station at 30 km ran out of water at 11:20; and the timing mats at the finish failed for 6 minutes at 12:48, so 38 times were entered by hand. The water shortage is the item the committee must act on.

edit.request: Add the 2027 target of 3600 finishers to the chart, and change the 60 and over median finish time from 4:41 to 4:38 everywhere.
